data.title: bn-23g: trusted effectful verification and inert instrument conclusions

data.body: [HIGH] Preserve the committed recovery identity on acquisition failure. By this branch, declare has durably accepted the run, and ExecutionFailure separately carries recovery.run_id, recovery.request_key, capture_handle, and effects. The handler discards the run ID and capture selector, exposes only the ambient request key, changes commit_status to unknown whenever effects are non-none, and tells the operator to use that request key even though no CLI command accepts a request-key recovery selector. The frozen response contract defines commit_status as durable coordination state and effects as the independent external-effect dimension. This can leave a failed effectful run impossible to inspect directly and encourage rerunning verify, which mints a new key/run and can duplicate target effects. Return the exact typed recovery selectors (at minimum the accepted run ID and request key, plus the capture handle when present), provide a safe inspection/recovery action, and keep commit_status committed after declaration while reporting effect uncertainty only in effects. risk:high checklist: failure modes: partial target effects, SIGKILL/adapter failure after intent, recovery-read failure, or capture finalization failure lose direct correlation and may be retried as fresh work; edge cases: effects observed versus unknown, absent/present capture handle, failure before/after first durable step, and concurrent run listing; rollback: disable or revert effectful verify until failed runs retain their selectors, and reconcile already accepted runs by durable run ID rather than issuing fresh verification; monitoring: alert on effectful verification errors without a run ID/recovery action and on repeated verify declarations for the same lead/revision; input validation: do not accept a caller-selected result or record, but project the service-issued ExecutionFailure recovery values verbatim and verify they match the declared acceptance.

data.reason: BLOCK at exact target fdfa4a7441ed8a09d9f81ccc40209dc39b7d5c65 (full-range binary patch SHA-256 94ca33aa873c26e7a4b64dc183d3f434834f31ae86067108d04bbfdb9cc1eb7e): th-36bbc9 is a risk:high failure-recovery defect. After durable declaration, acquisition errors discard the accepted run ID/capture recovery data, misstate known committed coordination state as unknown based only on external effects, and direct operators to a request-key recovery path absent from the CLI. A fresh retry mints another run and can duplicate target effects. All supplied offline validation hashes matched; the unavailable pinned disposable Teapot remains an honest live-qualification limit and no traffic was sent.

data.body: Fixed in dd9c771906ea456bc56913c33a8b3435fde38526 (repair diff SHA-256 518269acf713143c978d6580a530e188445316b835f25d3245c19c574c708055). Before declaration no request selector is projected. Every post-declaration failure now projects the exact accepted typed run_id/request_key, capture_handle when present, commit_status=committed for effects none/observed/unknown, and one effects=none 'show <run> --depth full' inspection action; it never advises verify/retry. ExecutionFailure recovery is compared to the accepted RunAcceptance before attribution, and mismatches fail as INTEGRITY_FAILURE while retaining only the accepted selector. Focused recovery JSON/text/effect/mismatch tests passed (ae8629867c62c1e43d0fe0533ddd4967f825e3aede5204b52ae29ca516897d34); host CLI tests df45e93d013b7384da71b65e8f1b15096ccd91c53dc8b323bf3b4b44bb565382; effect witness ba1c9741acf683a8894b076d1eb0ee38406e27d7119840dad9f8726619934147; rounds error 37d7fed9cbc37ac9554b66b6f64458090cdee4f6ec26c668b32f36530bbf6673; SIGKILL 9f3facc7ec7047edb51cf228bd5eb30c9f9e005118d1149908118ab4d35597d6; strict Clippy 90c74f61a7967fd6b5744b613e1b5e9d73162839b18c0f902379b4beb4c0e648; serialized offline just check 9d172ba5a2ea5fc9c25710b69b82f2202d29939273e7459ebcd939ec479ec9ca. No external target traffic.

data.reason: Fixed in dd9c771: accepted recovery identity, committed status, capture projection, and read-only show action verified.

LGTM at exact target dd9c771906ea456bc56913c33a8b3435fde38526. Independently verified complete base..target full-index binary SHA-256 ad131b672ba21db6bccd9cd6c5675b4780777e8c5ed4e137b977511960611b9a and repair-only SHA-256 518269acf713143c978d6580a530e188445316b835f25d3245c19c574c708055. th-36bbc9 is resolved: pre-acceptance failures expose no selector; every post-acceptance failure uses the exact accepted run ID/key, committed durability stays separate from none/observed/unknown effects, the service recovery tuple is checked before attribution, foreign capture data is withheld on mismatch, and the only next action is effects-none show <run> --depth full with no verify/retry route. Full-range admission, exact two-round execution, evaluator-owned publication, qualified coherent readback, inert producer metadata, and absence of caller verdict/result/record inputs remain intact. All seven supplied repair-log hashes and the previously verified full-range logs match; independent focused recovery tests pass 3/3. The unavailable pinned disposable Teapot remains a disclosed live-qualification limit: the candidate failed its exact hash gate before traffic, the pin was not weakened, and the static plus comprehensive offline evidence is sufficient for this repair and full-range approval. No findings.
